welcome.title: Open a video.
welcome.titleMuted: Kino remembers the episode and the second where you stopped.

seasons.title: Seasons sort themselves
seasons.text: By file names: S02E05, 2x05, “Episode 5”. Natural order — 2 comes before 10.

tracks.title: Audio is remembered per series
tracks.text: Pick a dub once — the next episodes use it. External .ass/.srt are found too.

resume.title: Continue in one click
resume.text: Home shows what you watched, which episode and the second you stopped at.
